lines.beaver: 와, 동물이 정말 많네요! 뭐가 보여요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, there are so many animals! What do you see?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, dongmuri jeongmal manneyo! Mwoga boyeoyo?
lines.learner: 돼지가 진흙에 누워 있어요. 정말 귀여워요.
lines.en: A pig is lying in the mud. It's so cute.
lines.roman: Dwaejiga jinheulge nuwo isseoyo. Jeongmal gwiyeowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, is it sleeping? What about other animals?
lines.learner: 저기 코끼리가 물가에 서 있어요. 아주 커요.
lines.en: An elephant is standing by the water. It's huge.
lines.roman: Jeogi kokkiriga mulkkae seo isseoyo. Aju keoyo.

lines.beaver: 코가 정말 길어요. 무서운 동물도 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Its trunk is so long. Are there scary animals too?
lines.beaver_roman: Koga jeongmal gireoyo. Museoun dongmuldo isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 호랑이가 바위 위에 앉아 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, a tiger is sitting on a rock.
lines.roman: Ne, horangiga bawi wie anja isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 우아, 눈이 무서워요. 또 뭐가 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Whoa, its eyes are scary. What else is there?
lines.beaver_roman: Ua, nuni museowoyo. Tto mwoga isseoyo?
lines.learner: 뱀이 나무에 감겨 있어요. 조금 무서워요.
lines.en: A snake is wrapped around a tree. It's a bit scary.
lines.roman: Baemi namue gamgyeo isseoyo. Jogeum museowoyo.

lines.beaver: 으, 저는 뱀이 싫어요. 저쪽으로 가요.
lines.beaver_en: Ugh, I hate snakes. Let's go over there.
lines.beaver_roman: Eu, jeoneun baemi sireoyo. Jeojjogeuro gayo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 여기는 꽃이 많이 피어 있어요.
lines.en: Okay. Lots of flowers are in bloom here.
lines.roman: Joayo. Yeogineun kkochi mani pieo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, the flowers are really pretty!
lines.en: A staff member is planting flowers over there.

lines.beaver: 와, 꽃이 정말 다양하네요. 저건 뭐예요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, there are so many kinds of flowers. What's that?
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, kkochi jeongmal dayanghaneyo. Jeogeon mwoyeyo?
lines.learner: 긴 줄기에 큰 꽃이 달려 있어요.
lines.en: A big flower is hanging on a long stem.
lines.roman: Gin julgie keun kkochi dallyeo isseoyo.

lines.en: A bee is sitting on the flower. Be careful!

lines.beaver_en: Oh, thanks. Thanks to you, I didn't get stung.
lines.en: No problem. We saw lots of animals today.

lines.beaver: 네, 정말 재미있었어요. 밥 먹으러 가요!
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it was really fun. Let's go eat!
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, jeongmal jaemiisseosseoyo. Bap meogeureo gayo!
lines.en: Sounds good. Let's come again together.
